provenance.source_title: Your Life as a Gladiator at Every Level

examples.psychological_goal: 用章节卡+宿命从句开场
examples.expression_mechanism: 层级章节卡+时间状语（士兵来的那年你19岁）
examples.example_text: Level one, the captive. You are 19 years old when the soldiers come.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「第X级+绰号」开场卡，把年龄嵌进灾难从句里，一句定格命运
examples.negative_instruction: 绰号必须是即将被剥夺的身份（captive），不可中性

examples.psychological_goal: 先给观众一件最小的珍宝再夺走
examples.expression_mechanism: 最小珍宝标记（笑声=最后一件好事）
examples.example_text: He grips your finger and laughs when you lift him. That laugh is the last good thing
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在劫掠前用一个婴儿动作+「最后一件好事」的判词，让失去可计量
examples.negative_instruction: 判词必须紧跟画面，不可隔段补刀

examples.psychological_goal: 用三个否定短句颁布生存法则
examples.expression_mechanism: 法则三连（不跑/不打/活下来）
examples.example_text: You do not run. You do not fight. You survive. That is all there is now.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「不做A，不做B，只做C」把新世界规则压成戒律
examples.negative_instruction: 戒律必须在实例（逃跑的男孩）之后颁布，不可空降

examples.psychological_goal: 用名词降级完成去人化
examples.expression_mechanism: 名词降级（人→价格）
examples.example_text: You are not a person here anymore. You are a price.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「你不再是人，你是X」给交易场景定性
examples.negative_instruction: X必须是集市机制的直接产物（price），不可抽象

examples.psychological_goal: 用「这也是故意的」揭示设计逻辑
examples.expression_mechanism: 反直觉设计+目的标注（木剑比真钢重）
examples.example_text: The wooden sword is heavier than real steel. This too is on purpose.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给反直觉事实，再用一句话揭示它是设计而非疏忽
examples.negative_instruction: 目的标注必须简短（on purpose），解释留给读者

examples.psychological_goal: 拆穿优待的真实会计逻辑
examples.expression_mechanism: 优待卸妆（不是善意，是投资）
examples.example_text: This is not kindness. You are an investment. A dead investment earns no one anything.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「这不是X，你是Y+Y的会计逻辑」拆穿一切温柔
examples.negative_instruction: 第三句必须沿用Y的词性（investment），不可换比喻

examples.psychological_goal: 用导师三连传授恐惧管理
examples.expression_mechanism: 导师三连（恐惧是声音/穿过你/照样移动）
examples.example_text: He tells you fear is just a sound. He tells you to let it pass through you. He tells you to move anyway.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用 He tells you 三连把心法课压成可背诵的口诀
examples.negative_instruction: 三连必须落在一个动作上（move anyway），不可停在安慰

examples.psychological_goal: 用自我背叛三拍写异化开始
examples.expression_mechanism: 自我背叛三拍（想要/恨想要/还是要）
examples.example_text: You begin to want to be good at this. You hate yourself for wanting it. You want it anyway.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「想要—恨想要—还是要」的三拍写人格被改造的第一步
examples.negative_instruction: 第三拍的 anyway 是关键，不可写成被说服

examples.psychological_goal: 用目的状语给首杀定性
examples.expression_mechanism: 目的状语定罪（为了取悦陌生人）
examples.example_text: You kill a man you never met to please strangers.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把动作写得越平静，目的状语（to please strangers）越像判决
examples.negative_instruction: 整句必须是陈述事实的口气，不可加情绪词

examples.psychological_goal: 用症状的消失标记更深的病
examples.expression_mechanism: 症状消失=病入更深（不再呕吐）
examples.example_text: You stop vomiting in the tunnel afterward. You do not know if that is good or terrible.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「好转信号+好坏未明」标记麻木的开始
examples.negative_instruction: 不可自己回答是good还是terrible，留给读者

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话点破娱乐业的需求本质
examples.expression_mechanism: 需求纠偏（不要屠杀，要英雄故事）
examples.example_text: The crowd does not want a clean slaughter. The crowd wants a story with a hero standing in it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「不要A，要B」纠偏观众对娱乐需求的误判
examples.negative_instruction: B必须可执行（hero story），为后文「喂给他们」铺路

examples.psychological_goal: 用牲畜比喻定性格奴化巅峰
examples.expression_mechanism: 牲畜+资本双比喻（公牛/两条腿的钱）
examples.example_text: You are his bull now, his money walking on two legs.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「他的A，他的B」双所有格把人物价值动物化
examples.negative_instruction: 两个比喻必须同向（牲畜=资本），不可冲突

examples.psychological_goal: 用新的计数方式把希望量化
examples.expression_mechanism: 计数方式翻转（数剩下的，不是数活过的）
examples.example_text: Not fights survived, but fights remaining until the door opens. Each victory is a single coin laid down toward that door.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「不数A，数B+每个B是一枚硬币」把遥远希望变成可攒的东西
examples.negative_instruction: 门必须是前文建立的门（自由之门），不可新造意象

examples.psychological_goal: 用安静的失去对比血腥的恐惧
examples.expression_mechanism: 恐惧重排（安静的失去>任何对手）
examples.example_text: That quiet loss frightens you more than any opponent ever has.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「X比任何Y都让你恐惧」把最大恐惧从肉体换成遗忘
examples.negative_instruction: quiet 是关键：必须是正在发生的遗忘，不是已发生的死亡

examples.psychological_goal: 用「背着」给最重的一战记账
examples.expression_mechanism: 负重记账（那一场你永远背着）
examples.example_text: He gave the killing signal anyway. You carry that one with you always.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用carry+指示词（that one）给无法言说的事件建档
examples.negative_instruction: 前文必须已交代事件全貌，指示词才有重量

examples.psychological_goal: 用笼子辩证法写自由的眩晕
examples.expression_mechanism: 笼子辩证法（笼子给你身份/笼子没了答案也没了）
examples.example_text: The cage told you who you were. Now the cage is gone. So is the answer.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「X给了你Y，X没了，Y也没了」写制度化的后遗症
examples.negative_instruction: answer 必须对应 who you were，不可写成「自由」

examples.psychological_goal: 用劝告与预知写制度的引力
examples.expression_mechanism: 劝告失效预知（别回来/他会回来/沙地留儿子）
examples.example_text: You tell him not to come back here. You know he probably will. They almost always do. The sand keeps its sons.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「你劝A，你知道会B，他们总B」三拍写个体劝告在制度前的无力
examples.negative_instruction: 最后一句必须是制度拟人化（sand keeps），不可归因于个人选择

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话完成共犯自认
examples.expression_mechanism: 共犯自认（从几乎毁掉你的东西中获利）
examples.example_text: You profit from the cruelty that nearly destroyed you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「从X中获利，X差点毁掉你」一句话完成受害-加害的闭环
examples.negative_instruction: 句中必须同时出现获利与受害，不可只说一边

examples.psychological_goal: 用身份清单+全否判词结清一生
examples.expression_mechanism: 清单全否（你是这一切，没一样是你的选择）
examples.example_text: You were all of these and not one of them was ever your choice.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先列全部身份，再用一句全否把它们同时作废
examples.negative_instruction: 身份清单必须是各级章节卡的原词（captive/killer/champion...）

examples.psychological_goal: 用预置道具完成循环警告
examples.expression_mechanism: 预置道具（写着名字的锁链在等他）
examples.example_text: He does not know that a chain waits somewhere with his name upon it. He will learn. They always do.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「他不知道X在等他+他会知道，他们总是知道」把结局变成预警
examples.negative_instruction: 道具必须是开场主角遭遇过的（锁链），不可新造威胁
